title: equilabium subincisum
intro: Equilabium subincisum, commonly known as Subincisum, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Asia and is traditionally used in various folk medicines due to its potential health benefits. The plant is said to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
